metric: Actual main-thread callback gaps, not presented frames or FPS. Longest gap overlapping operation to +700ms.
counter_interval: Counters reset at operation and snapshotted at verification approximately +1000ms. They are not scoped to the longest callback gap.
comparison_notes: Each cohort uses a fresh same-build none baseline. Source extraction/conditional view structure and diagnostics changed between builds; do not compare absolute medians across cohorts as optimization evidence.
Build 1 observers/counters are enabled. Build 2–4 timing cohorts have diagnostics disabled. Separate diagnostics validate heights and count bodies.
Final launch order rotates directions and variants each cycle: prepend/append/no-insertion × none/flat-markdown/content-only, then rotate each list left once per cycle.

All variants retain the same corpus SHA-256. Content-only retains actual header/avatar/profile, Markdown, quote, reaction components but removes unused row state, domain branches and outer row interaction chrome.
Flat-markdown removes singleton collection wrappers, with identical styled text and production rich children; static results do not validate streaming identity transitions.

bare_smoke.note: One pair verifies the bare build and diagnostic/reveal runner. Not a repeated performance comparison.
